map.综合衡量实际承担的税负水平。: Comprehensively measures the actual tax burden borne.
map.📖 查看「实际税率 = 总税额 ÷ 税前所得 使用指南」: 📖 View Guide: "Effective Rate = Total Tax / Pre-tax Income"
map.低于名义税率说明有减免。: Below the statutory rate indicates exemptions or reductions.
map.用总税额 ÷ 税前利润衡量企业真实税负，剔除优惠与扣除的影响。: Use total tax / pre-tax profit to measure true burden, net of preferences and deductions.
map.跨年度、跨辖区对比有效税率（ETR）。: Compare effective tax rate (ETR) across years and jurisdictions.
map.评估税会差异、减免对整体负担的影响。: Assess the impact of book-tax differences and relief on overall burden.
map.若因减免税额降到 15 万、税前利润不变，则 ETR=15%，比法定 25% 低: If tax falls to 150K via relief while pre-tax profit holds, ETR=15%, 10 points below the statutory 25%.
map.实际税率与法定税率为何不同？: Why does effective differ from statutory rate?
map.法定税率是名义档，实际税率受优惠、扣除、亏损结转等影响，通常低于法定税率。: Statutory rate is the nominal bracket; effective rate is usually lower due to preferences, deductions, and loss carryforwards.
map.ETR 越低越好吗？: Is a lower ETR always better?
map.不一定，过低的 ETR 可能来自一次性减免或暂时性差异，需结合可持续性判断。: Not necessarily; an overly low ETR may stem from one-off relief or temporary differences, judged on sustainability.
map.实际税率 ETR = 总税额 ÷ 税前所得 × 100（%）；联动卡：税后所得: Effective tax rate ETR = total tax ÷ pre-tax income × 100 (%); linked cards: after-tax income = pre-tax − tax, ETR as a decimal = tax ÷ pre-tax, pre-tax to tax multiple = pre-tax ÷ (tax||1). Validation: both fields required; pre-tax income is the denominator and = 0 reports an error, all-zero input reports an error. Rule: no fixed grading; the higher the ETR the heavier the overall tax burden, and 0 means tax-free.
